fusions.name: Fry From the Underside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 silver fry from the shelter under your shell, spread apart, each one dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Glide
fusions.desc: You glide shell-first along a slick of scales to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and it deals 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. The target is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slips the Net
fusions.desc: Raises a slick shell barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slip, Then Settle
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and you settle into a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
